scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
